{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue_completed"}
